title.zh: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
title.en: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval

current_state.zh: Moody's assigned A2 long-term and P-1 short-term deposit ratings to Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD stablecoin, citing reserves held mostly in short-term U.S. government assets and cash with a target of 103% coverage, one day after Ripple's Standard Custody & Trust Company received final OCC approval for a national trust bank charter.
